items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I had the opportunity to be a side man cause Cab offered me a job, you know, when we first got here.

ctx.x: I had the opportunity to be a side man cause Cab offered me a job, you know, when we first got here. I had a few of them, you know. But, I stuck with the band
cause since the fellows were gonna stick with me, I didn't think that I should leave them and go with someone else.
